title: Engine progress line
description: One line of JSON the engine prints on stdout as it works. An app reads the lines from its subprocess; the cloud wrapper copies the latest into the job record. Other stdout lines are log text and are ignored.

stage.description: What the engine is doing, e.g. sync, pitch, kits, ball, render, upload.

fraction.description: How far through the whole command.

event.description: questions/questions.json is written; the command ends after this.

output.description: The game video's path, relative to the job's output folder.

code.description: A stable code an app can act on, e.g. footage_corrupt, not_enough_disk.
